title: Pre-flight summary
subtitle: Review what was scanned before starting the import. Big mods can take a while — turn on background run to keep working while it imports.
etaHint: Rough estimate based on total file size. Actual time depends on your disk and computer.
backgroundToggleHint: Close this dialog and keep working. A widget in the bottom-right shows progress.
notAvailableHint: Counts marked “—” aren't available during the scan; they'll appear in the post-import summary.
